nodes.label: Favourite-Longshot Bias
nodes.rationale: Favourites (90-99c) underpriced (+1.28 to +1.38c EV/contract) and longshots (1-10c) overpriced (-2.24c EV/contract) — symmetric both-tails pattern treated as a real bias rather than a mined artifact. Dies above a 1.5c spread; only 3 of 4 quarterly samples positive.

nodes.label: Market Calibration Finding
nodes.rationale: Implied vs actual win rate matches within ~1 percentage point across price bands at T-60 — the market is otherwise well priced, so a better forecasting model will not find edge in the middle of the curve.

nodes.label: Affiliate Disclosure
nodes.rationale: Polymarket links in the app/docs are referral links; signing up through one may credit both user and authors.

nodes.label: No Paper/Demo Mode
nodes.rationale: Polymarket is mainnet-only with real USDC, so every engine places real orders with real money the moment it is enabled; all engines ship OFF by default.

nodes.label: Shadow Mode
nodes.rationale: Every new script starts in shadow: it runs against live ticks through every rail but the exchange call is replaced by a recorded entry, so a script builds a genuine forward track record before spending money. Closest thing the app has to a paper mode, placed exactly where risk is highest (user/AI-written code).

nodes.label: Resolution via Direct API
nodes.rationale: Reconciles unresolved positions against the Gamma market (closed + outcomePrices) and on-chain positions directly, so a settled market no longer sits in filled forever and blocks new trades.

nodes.label: Startup Reconciliation
nodes.rationale: reconcile_positions_with_polymarket() rebuilds the local book from live Polymarket positions on launch, so a crash mid-fill doesn't permanently inflate the count.

nodes.label: Script Risk Audit
nodes.rationale: Every script is statically scanned for network access, filesystem writes, subprocesses, credential-shaped names, dynamic execution, and obfuscation (flagged critical); shown on the Risk tab, re-surfaced when arming a flagged script.

nodes.label: Script Safety Rails
nodes.rationale: Max entry price, max contracts per order, max open positions per script, per-script daily-loss breaker, cap on concurrent scripts, one entry attempt per market window. Where a cap and exchange minimum contradict, entry is refused, never rounded up past the cap.

nodes.label: Old AST Whitelist Sandbox (deprecated)
nodes.rationale: Earlier versions validated scripts against an AST whitelist (no imports, no classes, curated builtins only). Blocked most useful Python while never being a real security boundary, so the app moved to review-instead-of-restrict.

nodes.label: Hook Wall-Clock Timeout
nodes.rationale: Every hook runs in a joined worker thread with a hard wall-clock timeout; an overrunning hook is abandoned and its script auto-disabled.

nodes.label: Money Rails Enforcement
nodes.rationale: Max entry price, max contracts per order, max open positions per script, per-script daily-loss breaker, one entry attempt per market window remain hard-enforced and unchanged even though the language sandbox was removed.

nodes.label: PyInstaller --selftest Gate
nodes.rationale: Imports every runtime dependency and signs an order offline before packaging, so a backend missing a dependency can never reach an installer.

nodes.label: Idempotent Signing
nodes.rationale: CLOB orders are EIP-712 signed locally and deduped by signal, so a restart never double-trades the same signal.

nodes.label: 65c Ask Cap Parameter
nodes.rationale: Fit to only 20 live fills; out-of-sample the 65-80c band is roughly neutral under honest fills (-0.12c/ct, t=-0.0), so the cap is neither supported nor contradicted — leave it, don't cite the old justification.

nodes.label: Baseline Fill Model
nodes.rationale: Fills at the ask observed on the tick the signal fires; overly optimistic — inflates edge especially in attractive-looking bands.

nodes.label: BTC 15m Price-Momentum Strategy
nodes.rationale: velocity1mPct > ±0.1 triggers a buy on that side. Original headline number (+28.50c/ct at 0.65) existed only as an unreproducible code comment in probe_btc_momentum.py, prompting this reproducible re-analysis.

nodes.label: Daily-Stop Interaction Risk
nodes.rationale: Most robust variant (1-10c band) has ~8.6% win rate; at ~5c entries the $1 min-notional forces ~20 contracts, so a run of ~20 losses is likely and can trip a -$20 daily stop even though the strategy is +EV.

nodes.label: Honest (Combined) Fill Model
nodes.rationale: Fills only if the ask was unchanged for the previous 15s AND still within 1c 5s later, filled at the later price — approximates whether the quote was actually there long enough to hit. Under this model ~95% of the 0.20-0.40 band's apparent entries disappear.

nodes.label: Crypto Deep-Favourite Trade Contrast
nodes.rationale: The same structural bet on Polymarket crypto 15m windows is negative in every band (0.95-0.98c -0.57c/ct, 0.98-0.99c -0.73c/ct at t=-3.1). Venue and market type matter more than the shape of the bet; do not generalize the sports result to crypto windows.

nodes.label: Windows DPAPI Credential Encryption
nodes.rationale: Credentials encrypted at rest with the OS keystore (DPAPI) tied to the user account, no key stored on disk in plaintext; non-Windows dev builds fall back to plaintext.

nodes.label: Script Backtesting
nodes.rationale: Deliberately pessimistic report: resting limits not modeled as maker fills, exit fills into a recorded bid flagged optimistic, script_max_open and daily-loss breaker not simulated — live is a rail-limited subset of the backtest, and it is in-sample by construction.

nodes.label: Sandboxed Scripts (AST validation)
nodes.rationale: AST-level validation (no imports/classes/dunder/frame access) under CPU/time budget is a guardrail against accidental damage and naive-malicious code, not a hard security boundary — CPython sandboxes are escapable by a determined attacker.

nodes.label: Trusted Mode
nodes.rationale: Skips language validation entirely and runs with the same privileges as the trading engine, in the process holding the decrypted wallet key. Only for scripts the user has read and understood. Bypasses the language sandbox only, never the money rails.
